landingHeroTitle: Ku Fuskanci Werewolf Kamar Ba a Taɓa Ganin Irinsa Ba
landingHeroSubtitle: Ku yi wasan rukunin jama'a na gargajiya da jarumai masu basira na AI tare da keɓantattun halaye, tarihin baya mai wadata, da tunani mai dabarun yaƙi.
landingFeaturesTitle: Juyin Juya Hali na Wasan da AI ke Ƙarfafawa
landingFeaturesSubtitle: Gano abin da ya sa Werewolf AI ya zama ƙwarewar rukunin jama'a ta ƙarshe
landingFeatureIntelligentAIDesc: Kowane wakilin AI yana da keɓantaccen hali, tunani mai dabarun yaƙi, da kuma iyawar tattaunawa mai jan hankali wanda samfuran harshe masu ci gaba ke ƙarfafawa.
landingFeatureMultilingualDesc: Yi wasa a cikin harsuna sama da 25+ tare da samar da fassarar atomatik da cikakken tallafin ƙasashen duniya.
landingFeatureDynamicDesc: Wakilan AI suna ƙirƙirar tarihin baya mai wadata da halaye waɗanda ke tasiri ga halayensu da yanke shawara a duk lokacin wasan.
landingFeatureImmersiveDesc: Rubutu-zuwa-magana mai inganci tare da haɗin ElevenLabs yana kawo jarumai rayuwa tare da keɓantattun muryoyi da halaye.
landingFeatureModernDesc: Kyakkyawan, mai amsawa wanda aka gina tare da fasahohin yanar gizo na zamani don wasan kwaikwayo mara kyau a duk na'urori.
landingFeaturePersistent: Ajiye & Ci Gaba a Kowane Lokaci
landingFeaturePersistentDesc: Kada ku taɓa rasa ci gaban ku tare da cikakken sarrafa yanayin wasa wanda ke ba ku damar adanawa da ci gaba da wasanni duk lokacin da kuke so.
landingAITitle: Haɗu da Abokan Hamayyarku na AI
landingAISubtitle: Wanda sabbin samfuran AI daga manyan masu samarwa suka ƙarfafa
landingAIOpenAIDesc: Tunanin ci gaba da tattaunawa ta zahiri tare da samfuran GPT-4 da GPT-3.5
landingAIClaudeDesc: Tunanin dabarun yaƙi mai rikitarwa da haɓaka halaye masu ma'ana
landingAIGeminiDesc: Sauri, ingantaccen aiki tare da sabuwar fasahar samfurin harshe ta Google
landingAIGroqDesc: Ƙarancin saurin gaske don wasan kwaikwayo na ainihi da amsoshi nan take
landingHowItWorksSubtitle: Fara cikin mintuna tare da kwararar wasanmu mai sauƙi
landingStep1Desc: Zaɓi ƙidayar 'yan wasa, samfuran AI, jigon wasa, da ko za ku shiga a matsayin ɗan wasa na ɗan adam
landingStep2Desc: Kalli yadda wakilan AI ke samar da keɓantattun halaye tare da sunaye, tarihin baya, da halaye
landingStep3Desc: Ku fuskanci tattaunawa mai ƙarfi, kaɗa ƙuri'a mai dabarun yaƙi, da matakan dare masu ban sha'awa
landingStep4Desc: Gano ko su wanene mayaudaran kuma ku ji daɗin ƙarshen wasan mai ban sha'awa
landingTechTitle: An gina shi da Fasahar Zamani
landingTechSubtitle: An ƙera shi da sabbin fasahohin yanar gizo da sabbin abubuwa na AI
landingCtaTitle: A shirye kake ka farautar Ƴan Dāwisu?
landingCtaSubtitle: Shiga ƙarni na gaba na wasan cire haƙƙin zamantakewa
landingRoleWerewolfDesc: Masu farauta masu wayo waɗanda ke farauta a ɓoye a cikin duhu yayin da suke kula da kamanninsu marasa laifi a lokacin rana
landingRoleVillagerDesc: Mutanen gari masu ƙarfin hali suna amfani da dabaru da cire haƙƙi don gano da kawar da barazanar ɗan dāwisa
landingRoleSeerDesc: Mai ba da shawara na sihiri wanda zai iya duba cikin rayuka kuma ya gano ainihin yanayin sauran 'yan wasan
landingRoleDoctorDesc: Jarumin mai warkarwa wanda zai iya kare 'yan wasa daga hare-haren ɗan dāwisa tare da ƙwarewar likitancinsu
landingFooterDescription: Gwajin wasan cire haƙƙin zamantakewa na gargajiya kamar ba a taɓa yin irinsa ba tare da haruffa masu hankali na AI.
landingFooterCopyright: An gina shi da kulawa ta amfani da Next.js da AI.
landingHeroBadge: Cire Haƙƙin Zamantakewa Mai Ƙarfin AI
landingFeaturesButton: Gwada Ɗan Dāwisa Mai Ƙarfin AI Yanzu
